Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks for the quick demo earlier. Short recap and the numbers we captured during the call so we have alignment before Ben & I put together a compact pricing proposal. Please confirm or correct any of the bullets below.

Key takeaways (please confirm):
- Primary use case: automated clinical note summarization + triage flags for nurses. Estimated 3 features in scope (Summaries, Prioritization, Suggested Responses).
- Expected traffic profile: 10–15M tokens / month initially (month 1–3 pilot), scaling to ~40–60M tokens / month in year 1 if the pilot succeeds.
- Budget range (annual): $80k–$150k suggested by procurement during the call; procurement team will confirm threshold for an RFP.
- Target commercial targets you mentioned: target gross margin ~55%+ on the feature(s), and CAC payback target of 6–9 months.
- Procurement asks: SOC 2 evidence + sample SLA; procurement@lumenhealth.com will lead the procurement thread.

Unit-econ asks we need you to confirm (we'll model after confirmation):
- Target packaged price per feature (we suggested a starter band in call): $X per feature per month at pilot scale — please tell us if you expect per-user or per-feature billing.
- Target $/1M tokens you want for a committed volume band (you mentioned a ballpark but I want this in writing).

Next steps (proposal timeline):
1) Internal sketch & unit-econ worksheet (Ben) — will share draft by EOD tomorrow (attached spreadsheet).
2) Short commercial proposal + pilot pricing (Markus & Ben) — draft to LumenHealth by Thu 8/12.
3) Procurement follow-up + SOC2 checklist (Marissa) — procurement contact to receive checklist by Fri 8/13.

Attached: feature-econ-draft.xlsx (workbook with assumptions) and a 1-pager pricing teaser.

If any of the numbers above are off, flag them in a reply and we will adjust. If everything looks good, can we book a 30-min follow-up for Wednesday 8/11 to run through the pilot agreement?

Thanks Markus — good recap. Confirming the items below and adding a couple clarifications:

- Token volumes: yes, pilot target is 10–15M tokens / month (we will start with ~12M/mo as a working number). If pilot succeeds we intend to double by month 6 and hit ~50M tokens/month by EOY.
- Budget: procurement is targeting ~$100k annual for an initial 6–9 month engagement (they may stretch to $140k if we get a clear payback path).

- Feature breakdown: we need per-feature $/month ranges for: (1) Summaries, (2) Prioritization rules, (3) Suggested Responses.
- SLA: we need a 99.9% uptime ask for the demo and pilot; SOC2 Type II will be required for production.

Sara / Markus — attaching a concise worksheet and the assumptions I used. Quick notes below (will include full tabulated math in the sheet):

Assumptions (inference cost basis):
- Baseline token execution cost to Redwood: ~$5.00 per 1M tokens at optimized batching and prefix caching for Summaries workload (pilot scale).
- Tail scenarios (heavy context / long summaries): up to ~$12.00 per 1M tokens when KV cache effectiveness is low.
- Operational overhead (ops, monitoring, SLA reserve): +20% on top of raw token cost for pricing cushion.

Target commercial math (goal: 55%+ gross margin):
- To hit 55% margin at $5 token cost -> price per 1M tokens = $11.11 (rounded to $11–12 / 1M).
- Recommended committed tier for 10–15M/mo pilot: $10–$13 / 1M tokens with a pilot minimum commit (e.g., 10M/mo for 3 months).

Per-feature starter bands (packaged pricing, pilot monthly):
- Summaries (primary): $3,500–$6,000 / month (assume avg 35–50k tokens per 1k notes; depends on note length).
- Prioritization (light-state ops + scoring): $1,200–$2,500 / month (low token per event, more calls but smaller payloads).
- Suggested Responses (higher latency sensitivity, more tokens): $2,000–$4,500 / month.

CAC payback sensitivity:
- If feature drives $6k/mo incremental revenue at gross margin 55%, expected monthly gross contribution ~$3.3k — with a CAC of $20k that implies ~6 months payback. We can tune price bands to meet 6–9 month payback targets by adjusting the committed $/1M or offering onboarding credits applied to CAC.

Pilot recommendation:
- Offer a 3-month pilot at $11 / 1M tokens with the per-feature starter bands above and a $10k onboarding credit applied to implementation services to accelerate acceptance. After pilot, roll into a committed tier (12-month) with volume discounts to reach $8–9 / 1M at higher volumes.

I've attached the full workbook (feature-econ-draft.xlsx) with the math. Happy to tighten assumptions if LumenHealth can provide avg token/sample lengths by feature.

—Ben
